@rule2 cols foot
@obs body: the rules of the frame are printed heavy outside and thin inside, the rules between the groups of the years heavy (about 1.9 pt); set as in the other tables.
@obs body: the hyphens of «al-muḥarram», «’l-qa‘dah», «’l-ḥiǵǵah» and of the Persian months («-māh») are printed longer, like en dashes; transcribed -.
@obs body L5, L7: a speck like a colon and a dot are printed below «ṣafar»; not transcribed.
@obs body L5: a dot is printed below the hyphen of «ardibihisht-māh»; not transcribed.
@obs body L1: a dot is printed to the right of «f. 241,r.», above it; not transcribed.
